name: stars-query
description:
This tool queries a database table that holds information about stars . The question should be a natural language question.

star database containing catalog IDs, position, distance, magnitude, spectral type, luminosity, constellation, and variable star data.

Field Name,Type,Key / Required,Description
id,Integer,Primary Key Required,Database primary key
hip,Integer,Optional,Hipparcos catalog ID
hd,Integer,Optional,Henry Draper catalog ID
hr,Integer,Optional,Harvard Revised / Yale Bright Star catalog ID
gl,String,Optional,Gliese Catalog of Nearby Stars ID
proper,String,Optional,"Common name (e.g., Sirius, Barnard's Star)"
ra,Float,Required,"Right ascension, epoch/equinox 2000.0"
dec,Float,Required,"Declination, epoch/equinox 2000.0"
dist,Float,Required,Distance in parsecs (≥100000 indicates missing/dubious parallax)
pmra,Float,Optional,"Proper motion in RA, milliarcseconds/year"
pmdec,Float,Optional,"Proper motion in declination, milliarcseconds/year"
rv,Float,Optional,Radial velocity in km/sec
mag,Float,Required,Apparent visual magnitude
spect,String,Optional,Spectral type
ci,Float,Optional,Color index (blue mag - visual mag)
bayer,String,Optional,Bayer designation
flam,String,Optional,Flamsteed number
con,String,Optional,Standard constellation abbreviation
comp,Integer,Optional,Companion star ID in multiple star system
comp_primary,Integer,Optional,Primary star ID for this component
base,String,Optional,Catalog ID or name for multi-star system
lum,Float,Optional,Luminosity as multiple of Solar luminosity
var,String,Optional,Variable star designation
var_min,Float,Optional,Variable star minimum magnitude (V scale)
var_max,Float,Optional,Variable star maximum magnitude (V scale)
